knownDisturbances.description: A mistaken numeric text search streamed several gigabytes during late round1. It is terminal; no graph process was stopped. Exact timing impact is unmeasured.

timingContext.disposition: Preserve every sample. Use independent decoding for integrity, but do not make a clean performance claim from this run or remove individual samples after observing timings.
timingContext.nextComparison: Separately registered fresh-process runtime comparison after this run and independent integrity audit finish.

scope: Historical complete-lesson engineering replay; no G0, transfer or time-to-success claim
limitations: Elapsed totals cover measured matched lessons, including their original pacing and durable evidence.
Simulation-only forward time excludes hashing, persistence, sleep and setup.
Phase timers can nest; do not add arbitrary phases.
Cold invocation includes warmup, setup and checks when separate runtime batches exist.
These lesson samples are not an observed duration for the entire curriculum.
